subject: Combine events to eliminate redundant kevent(2) calls (#638)
reason: The change only touches src/ae_kqueue.c, the kqueue event-loop backend that is compiled solely on BSD/macOS (HAVE_KQUEUE); the fuzzer runs on Linux, where Valkey uses the epoll backend, so the changed code is never built or executed and no scenario can reach it. The change is also a pure syscall-batching refactor: merging the two EV_SET/kevent calls into one kevent call with a two-entry changelist preserves the return contract (0 on success, -1 on error, deletes ignore errors) and alters no observable server behavior.
